title: Green Dog in Surreal Landscape
description: A large glowing green dog with antler-like branches growing from its back stands in the foreground, its body covered in hearts and symbols. It has glowing pink eyes and a pink heart dripping from its chest, with a crystal ball showing a miniature version of the scene at its feet, set against a dystopian background with a pink hotel, polluted river, and industrial smokestacks under a twilight sky.
prompt: A large glowing green dog with intricate white branches and antlers growing from its back stands in a dark surreal landscape, its body covered in heart symbols and patterns, glowing pink eyes, a pink melting heart dripping from its chest, a crystal ball at its feet containing a miniature scene of the dog, surrounded by broken glass and purple flowers on black ground, in the background a winding polluted river leads to a pink and teal retro hotel with a glowing Hotel California sign, palm tree, industrial factories with smokestacks emitting smoke, distant purple mountains and a white ghostly figure, twilight sky with pink and blue hues, dark surreal atmosphere, detailed painting style
